purpose: Describe a change in ability or habitual behavior.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
Potential / nonpast verb + ようになる; negative verb + ようになる.
I have become able to read kanji.
I started taking a walk every morning.
Recently I have come to watch little television.
formation: Potential / nonpast verb + ようになる; negative verb + ようになる.
restrictions: It focuses on a transition rather than a single successful event.
mistake: Use potential form when the intended change is ability.
